description: Provider-neutral taxonomy for AI-related storage domains. Catalog definitions only; individual model providers, API platforms and external storage services are not represented as connected.

categories.name: AI Model Artifact Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Model weights, checkpoints, adapters and serialized model artifacts.

categories.name: AI Dataset Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Training, validation, evaluation and fine-tuning datasets with provenance and version metadata.

categories.name: AI Training Run Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Training run metadata, logs, metrics, checkpoints and reproducibility bundles.

categories.name: AI Inference Asset Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Inference inputs, outputs, cached artifacts and retained result metadata.

categories.name: AI Prompt and Context Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Prompt templates, context packages, retrieval references and version history.

categories.name: AI Embedding and Vector Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Embeddings, vector indexes, namespaces and associated metadata.

categories.name: AI Retrieval and Knowledge Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Knowledge corpora, retrieval chunks, source references and indexing metadata.

categories.name: AI Fine-Tuning Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Fine-tuning datasets, configurations, evaluation snapshots and resulting model artifacts.

categories.name: AI Evaluation and Benchmark Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Evaluation datasets, benchmark results, scorecards and comparison evidence.

categories.name: AI Multimodal Asset Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Image, audio, video and cross-modal AI input/output assets.

categories.name: AI Agent Memory Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Agent memory records, working context, episodic state and governed long-term memory.

categories.name: AI Workflow and Pipeline Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Workflow definitions, pipeline state, run artifacts and orchestration metadata.

categories.name: AI Governance and Audit Storage Ecosystem
categories.description: Lineage, access records, audit trails, policy evidence and governance metadata.
